title: One-Step Methods for ODEs
description: Initial value problems, Euler's method, Heun, Runge–Kutta, consistency and convergence order, step-size control.
html:
⏱️ One-Step Methods for ODEs

1. Initial Value Problem and Euler

$$y' = f(t,y), \quad y(t_0) = y_0, \qquad y_{k+1} = y_k + h\,f(t_k, y_k)$$

Example $y' = y$, $y(0) = 1$, $h = 0.1$

Euler: $1.1^{10} = 2.593742$, Heun: $2.714081$, RK4: $2.718280$, exact $e = 2.718282$.

2. Error and Order

Local error $O(h^{p+1})$, global error $O(h^p)$ (consistency + stability ⇒ convergence). Half step ⇒ error $/2^p$; $p \approx \log_2\frac{e(h)}{e(h/2)}$.

3. Heun and Runge–Kutta

$$\text{Heun: } y_{k+1} = y_k + \tfrac h2(k_1 + k_2), \; k_2 = f(t_k + h, y_k + hk_1)$$

$$\text{RK4: } y_{k+1} = y_k + \tfrac h6(k_1 + 2k_2 + 2k_3 + k_4)$$

Butcher tableau $\begin{array}{c|c}c&A\\\hline&b^T\end{array}$; explicit ⇔ $A$ strictly lower triangular. Consistency: $\sum b_i = 1$, $c_i = \sum_j a_{ij}$. Order 2: $\sum b_ic_i = \frac12$.

4. Systems and Step Size Control

  • ODE of order $m$ ⇒ first-order system (e.g. $u_1 = y$, $u_2 = y'$).
  • Euler lets the energy of oscillations grow: factor $(1 + h^2)$ per step.
  • Embedded pairs (Euler/Heun): $\mathrm{err} \approx |y^{(2)} - y^{(1)}|$, $h_{\text{new}} = 0.9h(\mathrm{tol}/\mathrm{err})^{1/(p+1)}$.

5. Typical Mistakes

  • Using the predictor as the final result in Heun's method.
  • Not carrying the time $t$ along in $f(t,y)$.
  • Confusing local and global error order.
